name: discovery-listing
comment_engines: Next 14 requires >=18.17. The upload routes used to need >=20 for the File global; they no longer do (src/lib/upload.ts), so 18.17 is the real floor. Production runs 18.19.

scripts.comment_build: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD stamps the commit into the bundle. Without it there is no way to tell a deployed build from a stale one — a debug endpoint answered in an OLD response shape and it took a round trip to work out the server had simply not been rebuilt. `|| echo unknown` so a tarball deploy with no .git still builds.
scripts.build: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) next build
scripts.comment_chart_preview: The chart panel is judged by LOOKING at it — a clipped axis stamp and a smeared phone window both passed the unit tests. Needs a running server; stubs the upstreams in the browser so it works with no egress.
